Test waves: a t27 spec's tests, simulated and drawn as waves

Verilog generated from a ternary MAC spec, driven by the spec's own test vectors under Icarus Verilog: clock, buses, pass marks. Drop a .vcd and it draws yours.

A file you open here is read by your browser only: it is never uploaded. The page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • specs/ternary/stream_ternary_mac.t27, its four test blocks (vendored at public/t27/files/specs/)
  • public/t27/t27_compiler.wasm, verilog target: module StreamTernaryMac
  • scripts/widget-data/test-waves-tb.v and test-waves.mjs, run under Icarus Verilog (iverilog, vvp); versions and sha256 in demo.json
  • A .vcd file the reader drops or picks: read in the browser with FileReader, never uploaded
